t: This is where Sky Mirror stood, a temporary sculpture by Anish Kapoor, displayed in Kensington Gardens in 2010 and 2011. Kapoor is a British Indian artist, born in Mumbai, who works in sculpture, installation and conceptual art. He went to school at the Doon School in India before moving to the United Kingdom to train at Hornsey College of Art and then Chelsea School of Art and Design. The work is no longer here, so what you see now is the park itself.
